fusions.name: Loam Upheaval
fusions.desc: Heaves the ground, dealing 14 earth damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 3 tiles and giving them Rot for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wedged Boulder
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Hurls a stone packed with spores up to 7 tiles that deals 24 rock damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Rampart
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of stone 5 tiles long for 8 seconds that nothing crosses. Enemies that touch it gain Rot for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Weathering
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You carry 8% earth resistance.
